title: Strong praise alongside vague honesty-led remarks
summary: This topic combines explicit best-purchase praise with a small set of design-flaw complaints, while many sampled fragments are too terse or incomplete to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews describe the G60 as an outstanding purchase and the best car the reviewer has owned.

negative.summary: Negative reviews mention unspecified problems or design flaws, but the examples are too limited to identify the exact issues.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments are largely isolated phrases using words like 'honestly' or incomplete statements that hint at praise or regret without enough context for reliable sentiment assignment.

limitations: Most sampled undetermined fragments are very short or incomplete, which prevents reliable interpretation of the underlying sentiment.
The topic is loosely tied together by recurring wording such as 'honestly' rather than a single concrete vehicle attribute.
Negative evidence is sparse and does not provide enough detail to specify which design flaws or problems are being referenced.
Samples are sentiment-stratified and not representative estimates of the full review population.
